summary: Shopify Inc. is a Canadian multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario that operates a cloud e-commerce management platform (CEMP) for retail point-of-sale systems. The company has over 5 million customers and processed US$292.3 billion in transactions in 2024, of which 57% was in the United States. Major customers include Tesla, LVMH, Nestlé, PepsiCo, AB InBev, Kraft Heinz, Lindt, Whole Foods Market, Red Bull, and Hyatt.
